message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia, Latin America, and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; hub for United and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for United Airlines and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; serves millions of tourists visiting theme parks. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the New York metropolitan area. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, D.C. | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the nation's capital. |
| Boston Logan International Airport (BOS) | Boston, MA | BOS | Hub for JetBlue and a major gateway to New England. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and connectivity, making them key hubs for both domestic and international travel.
